item.title: Edmunds: These are the new EVs we’re most excited about in 2026
item.description: BMW says the iX3 will offer about 400 miles of range, which is considerably longer than what many other current electric SUVs are capable of. That range is complemented by quick charging capability and compatibility with Tesla's Supercharger network for easy long-distance driving. The new iX3 will also boast sporty performance, a classy cabin design and BMW's latest infotainment technology.

item.title: Photos of revelers celebrating Holi, the Hindu festival of colors, in India’s Mathura
item.description: Hundreds of men and women gathered at a temple in the north Indian town of Mathura, believed to be the birthplace of Lord Krishna, one of the most revered Hindu gods with whom this festival is closely associated, to celebrate the festival marking the arrival of spring.
